## Quick Start

### 1. Install Dependencies
Make sure you have a [Nerd Font](https://www.nerdfonts.com/) installed (e.g., JetBrainsMono Nerd Font) to display icons properly.

### 2. Apply Configuration

Copy your preferred configuration to `~/.config/starship.toml`:

**Default Variant:**
```bash
cp config/starship-default.toml ~/.config/starship.toml
```
**Apple Variant:**
```bash
cp config/starship-apple.toml ~/.config/starship.toml
```
